findings.before: Sword whirlwind committed cost/cooldown on the owner only; no cast-specific authority receipt.
findings.fix: Ordered authority start/finish, cumulative stamina receipt, authoritative cooldown and invalid-state rejection.

findings.before: Ordinary per-hit firearm token bucket could reject crowded AOE; server had no cast target set.
findings.fix: Committed cast serial, one hit per target, shared damage/range snapshot; no per-target firearm budget.

findings.before: A retained gun projectile speed could classify whirlwind contacts as projectiles and skip wall checks.
findings.fix: Whirlwind always follows melee area exposure checks.

findings.before: Whirlwind stun/knockback/training lived after client damage forwarding returned zero.
findings.fix: Server confirms stun/knockback, rune effects and dash/whirlwind training once.

findings.before: Forward move budget did not require an accepted whirlwind cast.
findings.fix: Match move sequence to accepted cast; fixed direction, elapsed-time cap, authority movement lock, pending-channel retry.

findings.before: Local whirlwind read the inventory item after CommitState replaced the profile.
findings.fix: Capture needed weapon identity before commit; authority retains a cast item copy.
